statistics.deseasonalizing: monthly climatology subtracted per cell and per regional series

fdr.spatial_dependence: Neighbouring grid cells on the trend maps are correlated. The Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate control used on the maps is proven only for independent or positively dependent tests, so here it holds approximately: a single map can have more or fewer than 5% false discoveries. trendkit's Monte Carlo test measured a false discovery proportion of 0.059 +/- 0.007 (mean of 40 synthetic maps, target 0.05), but its synthetic cells were independent of each other, so it does not measure the effect of spatial correlation.

statistics.regional_mean: cos(latitude)-weighted mean over a fixed mask: the cells inside the box with data in at least 95% of the months, the same cells every month; a month is missing when more than 5% of the mask's area weight has no data
statistics.trend_estimator: Sen's slope, reported per decade in the variable's units
